messages:
alex: quick q - noticed some route flips in staging when we add a host glob like `*.eu.example.com` earlier in the list. traffic moves to default svc. anyone seen this?
marta: yep. seems related to prefix normalization and trailing slash mismatch + host glob ordering
kevin: I think the matcher sorts by specificity score, but host-globs currently get a +0 affinity vs exact host. that can make long prefix path wins.
samir: can you paste the route defs? our scoring should penalize host-glob less than exact host
alex: paste:
```
- host: "*.eu.example.com"
  path: "/api/v1/"
  service: payments-eu
- host: "pay.eu.example.com"
  path: "/api/v1"
  service: payments-eu-canary
```
alex: in staging the second route doesn't win even though host is exact
marta: aha, trailing slash difference. we normalize incoming path to trim trailing slash for matching but route path stored with trailing slash -> length calc wrong
kevin: proposal: normalize route paths on config ingest (strip trailing slash except "/") and compute specificity as tuple: (host_exactness (2 exact,1 glob,0 wildcard), path_segments, negative wildcards, capture_count)
samir: +1 but we need stable tie-breaker for rollouts. also console should show 'why this route matched' with the tuple
alex: can we avoid changing scoring suddenly? need safe rollout
marta: rollout plan: acceptance tests -> feature flag behind org config -> default to old scoring but enable per-tenant
kevin: edge case: service alias overrides. if a route has explicit `service_alias: payments` should that outrank host-exact? I think no, alias is not a tie-breaker
route-bot: lint result for routes.yaml: 2 warnings: host glob ordering may shadow exact match; trailing slash normalization recommended
samir: I can add a quick lint rule + console hint (popover) that shows "shadow warning" and recommended fix
alex: UX: On console, show 'matching score' and the key contributing fields (host type, path length, captures) and a link 'simulate request' cc @marta
marta: will mock up a small overlay. also add telemetry event `route.evaluation.debug` with reason tuple for failed matches
kevin: impl note: do not change runtime matching algorithm for private deployments without opt-in; config layer can expose normalized path and computed score to runtime
alex: sgtm. I'll write RFC with scoring tuple, normalization rules, rollout plan and console changes. ping when draft exists
marta: thx
kevin: lgtm
samir: I'll add lint PR
route-bot: deploy queued for routing-lint-fix branch
alex: thanks all :thumbsup:
